# Warehouse terms

Storage is charged at $0.85 per pallet per day. The first 5 days of each stay are free of charge.
Handling in and out is invoiced separately.

turns.prompt: Per contracts/warehouse-terms.md, what do we owe for storing 140 pallets for 23 days? Give dollars, two decimals.
